names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 29 Νοεμβρίου, «Όσιος Νεκτάριος “ἐπίσκοπος ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ”», with the rank word left off. The epithet «ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ» is the page's own and it offers no other.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Νεκτάριος “ἐπίσκοπος ἐν τῷ Σπηλαίῳ”»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 29 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn, no distich and no year. Its whole entry is one sentence saying that it has no details of the life of this Russian venerable father; it does not name the cave or the see, and this folder names neither on its behalf. The corpus keeps eight other folders whose personal name is Nectarios or Nectarius and none of them is a bishop of a cave.
